brand.name: Jeremi Aron
brand.tagline: Full-stack developer building useful web apps.

sentence.en: I build useful web apps with JavaScript and TypeScript, and I'm open to remote and local full-stack roles.
sentence.es: Construyo aplicaciones web útiles con JavaScript y TypeScript, y estoy abierto a roles full-stack remotos y locales.

set.name: Firma JA
set.mechanism: La firma en un sello: un monograma JA recortado en una placa de tinta con esquina cortada y una barra de cobalto; la grotesca de carácter y un mono para etiquetas.
set.expression_move: La placa recortada con el monograma JA y la barra de cobalto.
set.differs_by: Los devs usan corchetes o terminal; esto es un sello personal tipográfico con una esquina cortada y una firma de cobalto.

logo.concept: Un sello personal: la placa recortada con el monograma JA y una barra de cobalto, la firma de la marca.

rationale.claim: El monograma en una placa recortada convierte dos letras en un sello reconocible, no en tipografía suelta.
Un cobalto de firma con un cobalto profundo y arena: el sistema gana profundidad sin salir de la familia fría.
El mono de etiquetas añade una capa técnica y editorial sin competir con el display.

findings.message: light: link #2b4bf2 on text #1c1c1c is 2.75:1, below 3.0:1 (links distinguishable from body text without underline (WCAG G183); WCAG 2, no rounding)
light: ext-1 #dce2ff is 1.16:1 on the light background #f2f4f5; as a stripe, chart series or thin line it needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)

suggested_fix.how: use ext-1-600 for stripes, chart series and thin lines

findings.message: light: ext-2 #e9e2d6 is 1.17:1 on the light background #f2f4f5; as a stripe, chart series or thin line it needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)

suggested_fix.how: use ext-2-600 for stripes, chart series and thin lines

findings.message: light: border #ced4d7 on background #f2f4f5 is 1.36:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)

suggested_fix.how: darken by OKLCH L -0.22, same hue

findings.message: dark: link #6d93fd on text #f3f3f3 is 2.61:1, below 3.0:1 (underline links in dark mode (WCAG G183: without underline a link needs 3:1 against body text); WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: border #414141 on background #0f0f0f is 1.88:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
#2b4bf2 sits at the sRGB gamut edge (91% of max chroma); vivid colours like this often fall outside CMYK process gamut: specify Lab D50 + tolerance, check with the printer, consider a spot colour
Ou-Luo two-colour model scores #14161a + #2b4bf2 at -0.44 (negative = less harmonious on a grey CRT test, no context): model signal only; the pairing table in references/pairing.md takes precedence

findings.suggested_fix: fine if the brand never writes them (loanwords, names); else another family

Public Sans misses 1/319 GF Latin Core codepoints (reach beyond the brief's languages)

findings.message: Public Sans: ~22 KB WOFF2 for the brief's characters (one variable file, all weights; estimate)
